description: Data Supporting "Projections of Tropical Cyclone-driven Coastal Flooding Risk to Critical Infrastructure in the Bay of Bengal is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Coleman Peter Blakely (Argonne National Laboratory). This repository contains data supporting the manuscript titled "Projections of Tropical Cyclone-driven Coastal Flooding Risk to Critical Infrastructure in the Bay of Bengal". The contents include: BayOfBengal_Tide_results_present_climate.nc: the present climate tidal results as described in the manuscript. This includes the ADCIRC mesh information including connectivity and bathymetry. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
